conditions: Anonymous report labels retained; no condition labels inferred or inspected.

method.seed_matching: Same case, target/state, and causal problem supported by evidence. A keyed ergonomic mechanism can match without claiming a reproduced human error. Broad advice receives no seed credit.
method.unseeded_findings: valid_extra requires a substantiated defect beyond the key; false_positive requires contradiction or clear inapplicability; unsupported preserves true observations whose defect or impact is not established.
method.deduplication: Unique seed IDs per report and case. Repetition across independent reports is not a duplicate. Multiple observations describing one keyed causal issue receive one seed credit. The two completion-layer extras are distinct case occurrences of one additional issue family.
method.comparison: No precision, recall, overall quality score, condition ranking, or model/style judgment computed.

unresolved_disagreement_notes.note: Persistence after typing is confirmed in both cases. The fixtures validate on submit, and no contract for immediate or blur revalidation is supplied. Whether last-submit errors, especially retained aria-invalid in case 4, merit valid_extra remains open; this judgment does not declare the behavior harmless.
First-invalid focus would be assistance, but the local alert and associated inline error are already present. Keyboard or screen-reader recovery needs direct evidence before calling this a defect.
Mistap/cart-loss and missed-gaze consequences are inferred, although their keyed placement and error-locality mechanisms are supported.

Retained submit focus is accurate, but the supplied state also provides a nearby role=alert and associated inline guidance. A first-invalid focus requirement or actual recovery failure remains unproved.
Match to D-15 rests on the same top-only, nonlocal phone error; it does not establish that role=alert is never announced by assistive technology.
CSS geometry is measured. The millimeter conversion and predicted touch accuracy were not independently calibrated or tested.

The input records task_completed=null, and the limitation explicitly says case 3 was not started because the operator budget expired. Treat this case as unobserved, not a demonstrated clean run or verified completion.

The corrected value matches the source predicate while the previous invalid state remains. Submit-only validation explains the observation; the acceptable lifecycle of aria-invalid and potential user confusion remain open without a contract or accessibility trial.
No dialog nodes would not by itself establish absence of a runtime confirmation. The fixture source independently confirms the unguarded clear handler; accidental deletion was not exercised.
Use the same persistence criterion as R17 and R63. The observation is real; immediate clearing and a P2 impact are not established by corrected-value snapshots alone.
Use the same focus criterion as R17 and R42: a local alert plus associated inline phone guidance is present; no keyboard recovery failure is demonstrated.
The ARIA-disabled/native-disabled distinction explains the metadata. Keyboard traversal was not performed, and focusable ARIA-disabled controls are not automatically a defect.

Accepted as valid_extra only for the opaque completion layer retaining interactive checkout content below it, established by source and snapshots. It is one issue family across two case-specific occurrences; keyboard activation and screen-reader announcement remain untested.

summary.no_false_positive_assertion: No finding is contradicted or clearly inapplicable enough to classify as false_positive. Unsupported findings are not included as proved errors.

reviewer_limitations: One static bounded evidence pass; no browser, keyboard traversal, screen-reader trial, color-vision simulation, physical-device calibration, new test, or execution framework was used.
All 35 referenced JSON files and all 20 referenced PNG files were inspected; unchanged page-1 through page-4 fixture source was read to scrutinize causal and unseeded claims.

Source corroboration establishes mechanisms without converting them into operator-tested or human-measured outcomes. Mistap rates, gaze failures, confusion, abandonment, and duplicate payments remain unmeasured.
The benchmark key was accepted as the supplied matching reference; its literature, physical-unit conversions, simulated color differences, and ergonomic effect sizes were not independently validated.

Submit-only validation was established from source. No additional product requirement for live validation or first-invalid focus was supplied; stale aria-invalid semantics and actual assistive-technology impact remain open concerns.
Reported task completion is not independently certified for all cases. R63 case 3 is explicitly unobserved, and its input task_completed field is null.
No operators directory, sealed directory, parent session, condition protocol, skill source, README, or other workspace history was read. Fixture and evidence files were not changed.
